maya: Quick question — I'm triaging a batch of partial streaming responses and disconnects from last night in prod. Where do folks usually fetch raw WS traces + sample chunk logs? Dash link or playbook would save time.

sam: Check the streaming traces dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/streams/streaming-traces and the chunk-timing panel in streaming-chunks. For logs use lumberjack/kibana: https://logs.redwood.ai/app/kibana#/discover

sam: Quick trace query example:
```
service:streaming AND event:ws_chunk AND client_id:12345
``` 

jordan: If you have connection IDs, this Kibana filter works:
```
connection_id: "conn_abc123" OR trace_id: "trace-..."
```
Also look at span tags: `ws.frame.partial=true` and `frame_bytes`.

leah: FYI I tweaked the partial-frame alert yesterday to ignore < 250ms gaps (to cut noise). Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/WS+Partials+Runbook

harry: If you need raw tcp captures for deep diffs, we have a helper script on infra-runbooks: `scripts/grab-ws-pcap.sh` — but please coordinate with eng-infra and redact keys before posting.

ops-bot: deploy-bot rolled out streaming-patch v1.8 to prod at 2028-04-03T02:15:00Z

maya: Thanks — I have a few trace IDs: trace-0a1b2c, trace-0a1b2d. I'll paste a small sample chunk log below to save a lookup:
```
{"ts":"2028-04-03T01:52:12Z","connection_id":"conn_abc123","event":"ws_chunk","partial":true,"chunk_ms":1120,"bytes":512}
```

sam: Those chunk_ms >1s lines are the ones we care about. Can you open a quick follow-up ticket in #incidents with the trace IDs + sample logs? I'll pin dashboards and add links to the alert.

maya: Will do. Thanks team :thumbsup:
